# The question at the pharmacy counter

Mum wanted to ask about a new tablet but the people behind us were close enough to hear. We left without asking. A private consultation room exists, but its door looks like a staff entrance. The service was available and effectively hidden. I keep writing better questions for appointments when I might need to ask where a question can safely be spoken. [[Care arrangements]] needs that distinction.
